concerns.text: T003/T004 produce `data/results/metrics_per_subject.csv` — the primary per-subject evidence artifact — but T006's contract tests cover only `metrics.csv`, `stats.json`, and dataset metadata. The per-subject file has no schema and no verification task, so T003/T004's 'Check' clauses (file exists, values finite) are the only gate. Add a per-subject validation (field presence, enum values, finite SNR) to T006 or name the schema it validates against.

T005 says 'Merge the cohort-level statistical fields ... with the per-subject aggregates into the cohort-level result table data/results/metrics.csv, whose rows conform to output.schema.yaml (one row per electrode/condition)'. 'Merge with the per-subject aggregates' is ambiguous: output.schema.yaml has additionalProperties:false and no subject_id, so per-subject rows cannot appear in metrics.csv. State explicitly that metrics.csv contains one aggregated row per electrode/condition (per-subject rows stay in metrics_per_subject.csv) so the implementer doesn't attempt an impossible merge.

T010 check (1) must run 'before dataset download', and the dependency table says T010 'gates T001', yet T010 is sequenced last and its own Check requires running against 'the real dataset' (which only exists after T001). As written the pre-download gate is temporally unexecutable. Fix by either moving the dataset-ID/URL verification into T001 (invoking a shared function from verify_references.py) or restating T010's check (1) as a unit-testable check that does not require downloaded data.

T005 is too coarse for one task: paired t-tests + FDR, Cohen's d + benchmark file creation, topographic correlation against the T004 template, schema-conformant merge into metrics.csv, and stats.json emission — five distinct deliverables in one checkbox. Flag for atomization; each sub-deliverable already has a clear artifact and check.
